title: Emrys and the Alibi
author: Lior Underhill
blurb: Lena Whitlock, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
